Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1
ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE AND
PLANS
2815-19 S. Stewart Avenue

The Applicant seeks to rezone 2815-19 South Stewart Avenue from an MI1-2 Limited
Manufacturing / Business Park District to a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District to construct eight
(8) townhomes with attached single-car garages. The height of the building will be 30 feet, 9
inches. No commercial space will be provided. The surrounding area is improved with
residential uses and this application will bring the property into conformity with the surrounding
land uses.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, to increase the number of off street parking spaces by 100% of
the applicable standard pursuant to 17-13-1003-EE. Pursuant to 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant
seeks a variation to reduce the end wall setback from the street from 10 feet to 4 feet, 3.25 inches
pursuant to 17-13-1107-B. The Applicant further seeks all relief available under the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance required for the plans subject to the zoning map amendment.
